blocks.title: Wake up & get ready
blocks.detail: • 1 hr to dress and load the bags

blocks.title: Ride to MIA - drop-off at departures
blocks.detail:
• Drop-off at Door 13 on the departures level (Alaska counters 211-214, Concourse E) - no parking needed
• Early Monday - light traffic; ride time is an estimate from home

blocks.title: Alaska check-in & bag drop
blocks.detail:
• Bag drop closes 40 min before departure (7:01 AM)
• Holiday-week Monday - expect lines

blocks.title: TSA security (Concourse E)
blocks.detail:
• 5-8 AM is MIA's peak security window
• 30 min budgeted for a family of four

blocks.title: Breakfast - Starbucks (Concourse E)
blocks.detail:
• Post-security in Concourse E, Alaska's concourse
• Breakfast sandwiches, egg bites, oatmeal; hot chocolate for the kids
• Refill water bottles before heading to the gate
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE: about $30 budget for breakfast (2 adult drinks + light food, kids' hot chocolates and a snack). Airport menus and hours aren't posted; check the Starbucks or MIA app the morning of.

blocks.title: Walk to the gate & restrooms
blocks.detail: • Gate is posted on the boarding pass / Alaska app the day of

blocks.title: At the gate - boarding
blocks.detail:
• Boarding starts about 35-40 min before departure
• Families can pre-board

blocks.title: Alaska 316 - MIA → SEA - nonstop 6h52m — BOOKED
blocks.detail:
• Boeing 737 MAX 9, Economy
• Lands 11:33 AM Pacific (2:33 PM Miami time)
• Main cabin food is for purchase - snacks and soft drinks are free
• Packed lunch from home before landing
blocks.notes: Booked. 12,500 Atmos points + $5.60 per person x 4 = 50,000 points + $22.40; taxes paid with the BofA Atmos Ascent card ending 1029. Add each traveler's Atmos number to the reservation.
blocks.flag: BOOKED — seats 24C, 24D, 24E, 24F; $22.40 taxes paid on the BofA Atmos Ascent card ending 1029. Still to do: add each traveler's Atmos number to the reservation.

blocks.title: Deplane & walk to baggage claim
blocks.detail:
• Families rarely deplane first
• If arriving at an N gate, take the SEA Underground (trains every 3 min)

blocks.title: Baggage claim & restrooms
blocks.detail:
• Domestic arrival, no customs
• Alaska bags usually on the carousel within 20 min

blocks.title: To the Turo meeting spot
blocks.detail:
• Delivered to SEA - lockbox self check-in; exact spot and steps under READ INSTRUCTIONS in the Turo app
• Add Alaska 316 to the Turo trip so the host can track the landing

blocks.title: Turo pickup - 8 days — BOOKED
blocks.detail:
• 2021 Chrysler Voyager minivan, plate CDK6995 - host Casciuc (4.98, 648 trips)
• Walk-around photos in the app before driving off
• Host's 2 child seats are included - check they're installed snugly
• Check tire sidewalls for M+S or snowflake symbol (needed for the Sea-to-Sky)
• Return due Mon Dec 28, 4:00 PM at SEA
blocks.notes: Reservation 62505231. 8 days @ $64.12 = $513.00 - 1-week discount $25.65 + 2 child seats $50.00 + trip fee $10.00 + SEA delivery $60.00 + sales tax $65.95 = $673.30, auto-charged to Visa ending 6730 on Mon Dec 14. 2,400 mi included (300/day); $0.20/mi over.
blocks.flag: BOOKED — $673.30 auto-charges to Visa ending 6730 on Dec 14. NO damage/theft protection yet: add Turo protection (about $10.96/day) unless your own auto policy covers Turo cars in the US and Canada. Still to do: confirm driver's license in the app, add flight AS316.

blocks.title: Drive SEA → Hyatt Regency Seattle
blocks.detail:
• FROM Sea-Tac → TO the hotel
• ~14 mi via I-5 to 808 Howell St
• About 25 min on a Monday midday + buffer

blocks.title: Arrive Hyatt Regency Seattle - park & check in — BOOKED
blocks.detail:
• Hotel garage (no valet)
• Ask for early check-in; bell desk holds bags if the room isn't ready
• Regency Club (8th floor) open to Globalists
blocks.notes: Booked under Jennifer Borges: Regency Suite via Suite Upgrade Award, 15,000 points/night (Category 5) = 30,000 points, 2 adults + 2 children. Globalist: breakfast at Andare buffet, Regency Club access, free parking on award stays. The confirmation shows a $29/night destination fee for bookings from June 1, 2026 - usually waived on award stays; confirm at check-in.
blocks.flag: Official check-in is 4:00 PM - ask for early check-in; the bell desk can hold bags.

blocks.title: Settle in & get ready
blocks.detail:
• Showers, change, unpack basics
• If the room isn't ready: freshen up in the Regency Club

blocks.title: Walk to Westlake Center
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO Westlake Center (4th Ave & Pine St)
• ~0.4 mi to 400 Pine St
• Monorail station is on the 3rd floor

blocks.title: Monorail to Seattle Center
blocks.detail:
• FROM Westlake Center, 3rd floor → TO Seattle Center
• ~2-min ride; trains about every 10 min
• Pay at the station or tap a card
• Get off at Seattle Center - the platform is right beside the Armory
blocks.notes: One way: 2 adults x $4 + 1 youth (6-18) x $2 + 1 child (5 & under) free = $10. Fares effective Jan 1, 2025.

blocks.title: Winterfest train & village (Armory)
blocks.detail:
• The Armory is right beside the Seattle Center monorail platform - step off the train and walk straight in
• Model train and holiday village inside
• Free; $2 suggested donation to run the train
• Open daily 10 AM-6 PM Nov 27-Dec 31

blocks.title: Walk from the Armory to the Christmas Market
blocks.detail:
• FROM the Armory → TO Fisher Pavilion
• Out the Armory's west doors, across the International Fountain lawn to Fisher Pavilion on the far (south) side
• About 300 m - 4 min

blocks.title: Seattle Christmas Market
blocks.detail:
• Entrance at Fisher Pavilion, on the south side of the International Fountain lawn
• Season Pass holders use the dedicated Season Pass entry line
• Christmas carousel, walk-through tree, daily snow showers, Santa photos
• Heated Alpen Haus for warming up
• Lights come on around sunset (~4:20 PM) with the Space Needle lit overhead
blocks.notes: $64.99 = the Family Season Pass: market admission for all four of you (covers 2 adults + up to 2 youth aged 7-14; your 5-year-old is free anyway), unlimited visits through Dec 27, no timeslot needed. Single-day tickets instead: 2 adults x $23.59 (Dec 21 afternoon) + your 7-year-old at the youth rate shown at checkout - about the same total. Prices from the official ticket site, Oct 2026. The carousel may cost extra.
blocks.flag: Dec 19-23 are the busiest days - buy ahead.

blocks.title: Walk back to the monorail
blocks.detail:
• FROM Fisher Pavilion → TO Seattle Center monorail platform
• Back across the International Fountain lawn to the Armory - the monorail platform is right beside it
• About 400 m - 5 min

blocks.title: Monorail back to Westlake
blocks.detail:
• FROM Seattle Center → TO Westlake Center
• Board at the Seattle Center platform beside the Armory
• The ride ends on the 3rd floor of Westlake Center - take the escalators down to Pine St
blocks.notes: Same fare as the ride out: $10 for the family.

blocks.title: Walk to Purple Cafe
blocks.detail:
• FROM Westlake Center → TO Purple Cafe (4th Ave & University St)
• ~0.4 mi south on 4th Ave to University St (~8 min)

blocks.title: Dinner - Purple Cafe and Wine Bar
blocks.detail:
• 1225 4th Ave; upscale-casual American in a soaring wine-tower dining room
• Kids' menu: chicken strips, kids' noodles, beef sliders, steak & fries
• Open Mon 11 AM-9 PM - reserve the 5:00 table
• Roque & Jenny's return visit - first time here was 2017
blocks.notes: Bistro Burger $25 + Chicken Schnitzel $38 (adults) + Kids Chicken Strips $13 + Kids Beef Sliders $15 = $91.00. Water. + 10.35% tax ($9.42) + 20% tip ($18.20) = $118.62. Prices from Purple's Toast online-ordering menu, Oct 2026 (dine-in prices may differ slightly).
blocks.flag: Book 5:00 PM Mon Dec 21 for four.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• FROM Purple Cafe → TO the hotel
• ~0.6 mi, uphill to 8th & Howell (~15 min)
• Tired kids? A rideshare from the door is about 5 min

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail:
• Lights out 7:20 PM Pacific = 10:20 PM on Miami body clocks
• Everyone has been up since 4 AM Eastern

blocks.title: Breakfast - Andare (hotel buffet)
blocks.detail:
• Lobby level, buffet 6:30-11:00 AM
• Globalist breakfast benefit
blocks.notes: Covered by Globalist breakfast. Confirm at check-in how it applies to the kids.

blocks.title: Coats, shoes, out the door
blocks.detail: • Rain jackets - December is Seattle's wettest month

blocks.title: Walk to Pike Place Market
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO Pike Place Market (Public Market clock, Pike St & 1st Ave)
• 0.6 mi downhill, ~11 min at adult pace

blocks.title: Original Starbucks (1912 Pike Pl)
blocks.detail:
• The 1971 store with the original logo
• Line is usually shortest early in the morning
blocks.notes: Estimate: 2 adult drinks + 2 kids' hot chocolates. This location's own prices aren't posted online.

blocks.title: Pike Place Market walk-through
blocks.detail:
• Pike Place Fish Market - fish tossing at the main arcade
• Rachel the bronze pig, the neon Public Market clock
• Main Arcade stalls and the Down Under lower levels
• Post Alley & the Gum Wall
• Mornings before noon are the least crowded

blocks.title: Walk to Colman Dock (ferry terminal)
blocks.detail:
• FROM Pike Place Market → TO Colman Dock ferry terminal (Pier 52)
• Down the Overlook Walk to the waterfront
• 0.7 mi to Pier 52

blocks.title: Ferry terminal - tickets & boarding
blocks.detail:
• Walk-on fare paid in Seattle covers the round trip
• Walk-ons board about 10-15 min before sailing
blocks.notes: 2 adults x $11.35 round trip = $22.70. Ages 18 and under ride free. WSF fare as of Oct 2026.

blocks.title: 12:25 PM ferry to Bainbridge Island
blocks.detail:
• 35-min crossing, skyline views behind you
• Fall 2026 weekday schedule (valid Sep 20-Dec 26) - recheck sailing times on the WSF site before you go

blocks.title: Walk to Doc's Marina Grill
blocks.detail:
• FROM the Bainbridge ferry terminal → TO Doc's Marina Grill
• ~0.5 mi through Winslow

blocks.title: Lunch - Doc's Marina Grill
blocks.detail:
• On Eagle Harbor marina
• Burgers, sandwiches, fish & chips, kids' menu
• Open daily 10:45 AM-9:45 PM
blocks.notes: Big Doc Burger $22 + Chicken Cheddar Club $22 (adults) + Kids Chicken Strips $14 + Kids Grilled Cheese $10 (kids) = $68. Entrees only, water. + ~9.2% tax ($6.26) + 20% tip ($13.60) = $87.86. Prices from Doc's online menu, Oct 2026.

blocks.title: Waterfront Park playground
blocks.detail:
• FROM Doc's Marina Grill → TO Waterfront Park, Winslow
• Fenced playground with swings on Eagle Harbor, behind Town & Country Market
• Play structure is aimed at ages 2-5 - fine for a short run-around
• Free; restrooms in the park

blocks.title: Winslow Way & Town & Country Market
blocks.detail:
• FROM Waterfront Park → TO Town & Country Market
• Stroll Winslow Way, Bainbridge's main street
• Eagle Harbor Book Co. (big kids' section) and Calico Toy Shoppe along the way
• Town & Country Market, 343 Winslow Way E - local grocery with a deli

blocks.title: Walk to the ferry terminal
blocks.detail:
• FROM Town & Country Market → TO the Bainbridge ferry terminal
• ~0.4 mi down Winslow Way to the terminal

blocks.title: Board the return ferry
blocks.detail:
• No fare collected on the Bainbridge side for walk-ons
• Walk-ons board about 10-15 min before sailing; warm waiting room in the terminal

blocks.title: 3:50 PM ferry back to Seattle
blocks.detail:
• Skyline at dusk on the way in (sunset ~4:20 PM)
• Fall 2026 weekday schedule lists 3:50 PM from Bainbridge - recheck in the WSF app before you go

blocks.title: Walk off the ferry to the rideshare pickup
blocks.detail:
• Follow the Colman Dock signs down to the Alaskan Way curb
• Request the Uber as the ferry docks

blocks.title: Uber from Colman Dock to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• FROM Colman Dock → TO the hotel
• ~1.2 mi uphill to 808 Howell St, about 8-12 min in 4:30 PM traffic
• UberX seats all 4 - Uber has no car-seat option here, so consider packing travel boosters
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE: UberX about $16-20 for ~1.2 mi / ~10 min at weekday rush (Seattle has the priciest rideshare fares in the US because of its driver-pay rules) + ~$4 tip = about $22. Check the live quote in the app; surge after a ferry docks can push it higher.

blocks.title: Freshen up at the hotel
blocks.detail: • Restrooms, dry layers, a short rest - then grab the car

blocks.title: Drive to Little Water Cantina
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO Little Water Cantina
• ~2.5 mi north along Eastlake Ave to the east shore of Lake Union
• Street parking on Eastlake Ave and the side streets

blocks.title: Dinner - Little Water Cantina
blocks.detail:
• 2865 Eastlake Ave E - Mexican, with an enclosed heated patio over Lake Union
• Kids' menu (12 & under): fried fish taco, quesadilla or bean & cheese burrito, each with rice and beans
• Open Tue 11:30 AM-8:30 PM
• No reservations - walk in; 5:40 on a Tuesday is usually easy
blocks.notes: Baja Fried Fish Tacos (2) $19 + Carnitas Burrito $16 (adults) + Kids' Quesadilla, Rice & Beans $8 + Kids' Fried Fish Taco, Rice & Beans $9 = $52.00. Water. + 10.35% tax ($5.38) + 20% tip ($10.40) = $67.78. Prices from the restaurant's Toast online menu, Oct 2026; dine-in prices can differ slightly.

blocks.title: Drive back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • FROM Little Water Cantina → TO the hotel

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Lights out by 9:00 PM keeps 10 hrs of sleep before the 7:00 AM wake-up

blocks.title: Breakfast - Andare (hotel buffet)
blocks.detail: • Globalist breakfast benefit

blocks.title: Check out & load the car
blocks.detail: • Passports for all 4 in the front-seat bag, not the trunk

blocks.title: Drive Seattle → Canadian border
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO Pacific Highway border crossing (I-5 exit 275)
• ~110 mi north on I-5, straight through
• Restroom stop if needed around Burlington or Bellingham
• Before Bellingham, check WSDOT border wait times

blocks.title: Border crossing into Canada
blocks.detail:
• Pacific Highway crossing (exit 275) is often shorter for cars than Peace Arch (exit 276)
• Passports for everyone, including the kids
• Have the Turo rental agreement downloaded on your phone - it shows you're allowed to drive the car if the officer asks
• Holiday week - 20-45 min wait budgeted

blocks.title: Drive border → downtown Vancouver
blocks.detail:
• FROM the border → TO Joe Fortes (Robson & Thurlow)
• ~33 mi on Highway 99 into downtown (signs in km)
• No winter-tire rule on this stretch

blocks.title: Park near Joe Fortes & walk in
blocks.detail:
• Street parking or a nearby parkade around Robson & Thurlow
• Keep luggage out of sight in the trunk

blocks.title: Lunch - Joe Fortes Seafood & Chop House
blocks.detail:
• Vancouver seafood institution since 1985
• Weekday lunch 11 AM-4 PM
• Kids' menu - see the kids' menu photo link
blocks.notes: Fish & Chips C$32 + Salmon Cakes C$36 (adults) + Chicken & Waffles C$29 + Fish & Chips C$32 (kids, no kids' menu) = C$129. Entrees only, water. + 5% GST (C$6.45) + 20% tip (C$25.80) = C$161.25, about US$116 at ~0.72. Prices from the May 2026 lunch menu; kids' portions, if offered, would lower this.
blocks.flag: Book 12:45 PM Wed Dec 23 for four.

blocks.title: Back to the car & drive to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• FROM Joe Fortes → TO the hotel
• A few blocks to 655 Burrard St

blocks.title: Hyatt Regency Vancouver - valet, check in & relax — BOOKED
blocks.detail:
• Valet the car and luggage
• Early check-in requested (Globalist)
• Up to the room to unpack and rest
blocks.notes: Booked under Jennifer Borges: 4 nights x 25,000 points (Category 5) = 100,000 points + 1 night on a Free Night Award, 2 adults + 2 children; checkout 12:00 PM. Globalist breakfast at Mosaic Grille covers the family. Cost shown is valet: C$52/night x 5 = C$260, about US$187 at ~0.72 - ask whether it's waived on award stays.
blocks.flag: Official check-in is 4:00 PM - early check-in requested but not guaranteed.

blocks.title: Walk to the Coal Harbour seawall
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO the Coal Harbour seawall at Jack Poole Plaza
• ~0.4 mi down Burrard St to the water

blocks.title: Coal Harbour seawall at sunset
blocks.detail:
• Sunset ~4:15 PM over the harbour
• Floatplanes landing and taking off, North Shore mountains
• Digital Orca sculpture and the Olympic Cauldron
• Vancouver Christmas Market (paid entry) is at Jack Poole Plaza - walk past

blocks.title: Canada Place promenade
blocks.detail:
• Harbour views under the white sails
• Part of the west promenade is under construction; no holiday display this year

blocks.title: Walk to Gastown
blocks.detail:
• FROM Canada Place → TO the Gastown Steam Clock (Water St & Cambie)
• ~0.5 mi past Waterfront Station onto Water St

blocks.title: Gastown stroll
blocks.detail:
• Cobblestone Water St lit up after dark
• Gassy Jack statue in Maple Tree Square
• Stay on Water St and Maple Tree Square - avoid wandering south toward Hastings

blocks.title: Gastown Steam Clock
blocks.detail:
• Water St at Cambie
• Whistles every 15 min; the full show plays on the hour (6:00 PM)

blocks.title: Walk to The Old Spaghetti Factory
blocks.detail:
• FROM the Steam Clock → TO The Old Spaghetti Factory
• ~4 blocks east to 53 Water St

blocks.title: Dinner - The Old Spaghetti Factory, Gastown
blocks.detail:
• The chain's original Vancouver location, with a vintage streetcar inside
• Entrees include bread, green salad (or soup) and spumoni ice cream
• Kids' menu for ages 10 and under - drink and ice cream included
• Reservations recommended
blocks.notes: Lasagna C$21.25 + Chicken Parmigiana C$24.50 (adults) + Kids Spaghetti & Meatballs C$8.50 + Kids Chicken Tenders & Fries C$9.50 = C$63.75. Water for adults. + 5% GST (C$3.19) + 20% tip (C$12.75) = C$79.69, about US$57 at ~0.72. Prices from the Gastown menu, Oct 2026.
blocks.flag: Book 6:15 PM Wed Dec 23 for four.

blocks.title: SkyTrain back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• FROM The Old Spaghetti Factory → TO the hotel (via Waterfront → Burrard stations)
• Walk 5 min to Waterfront Station
• Expo Line 1 stop to Burrard Station (~2 min)
• Kids 12 and under ride free; tap a credit card to pay
• 2 blocks to the hotel

days.title: Christmas Eve - Grouse Mountain & VanDusen Lights (draft)

blocks.title: Wake up & get ready
blocks.detail:
• Snow pants, boots, gloves on; pack dry layers for the car
• Early start for the Christmas Eve crowds

blocks.title: Breakfast - Mosaic Grille (hotel)
blocks.detail:
• 2nd floor; buffet or a la carte
• Globalist breakfast covers 2 adults + 2 kids

blocks.title: Car from the valet
blocks.detail:
• Call down for the car at 8:00 before leaving the room
• Tip the valet C$5 (about US$3.60)
blocks.notes: Valet tip: C$5 when they bring the car up (about US$3.60) - US cash is fine too. Nothing needed at drop-off.

blocks.title: Drive to Grouse Mountain
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO Grouse Mountain base
• ~8 mi over the Lions Gate Bridge to the base of Grouse
• Christmas Eve is one of Grouse's busiest days - early arrival beats the lot and the Skyride line

blocks.title: Park at the Grouse base lot
blocks.detail:
• Pay with the PayByPhone app or at the machines
• Day rate covers the whole visit
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE from last season's posted rates: about C$12 for the day (C$10 for 3 hours), about US$9 at ~0.72.

blocks.title: Tickets & Skyride up
blocks.detail:
• Red Skyride to the summit, ~8 min (100-person tram)
• Family Mountain Admission (2 adults + 2 kids ages 5-12) - show the online ticket
• Early start beats the Christmas Eve lines
blocks.notes: Family Mountain Admission ticket C$229 (2 adults + 2 children 5-12), about US$165 at ~0.72. Grouse's posted rate; ticket is date-specific and non-refundable - buy online.
blocks.flag: Non-refundable and date-specific - buy 1-2 weeks out once you can see the forecast.

blocks.title: Sliding Zone - sledding
blocks.detail:
• Two groomed sledding lanes just west of the skating pond - quietest first thing
• Rent sleds at the Fireside Hut - C$5 each, no booking
• Activity start times aren't posted - check Today on Grouse that morning
blocks.notes: 4 sled rentals x C$5 = C$20, about US$14 at ~0.72 (Grouse's posted 2026 price).

blocks.title: Santa's Workshop
blocks.detail:
• Behind the skating pond - visiting Santa is free, no booking
• Line grows through the day on Christmas Eve (skipping the C$5 photos)

blocks.title: Sleigh ride
blocks.detail:
• Leaves from just behind Santa's Workshop; loops through the snowy summit forest
• Included with admission, walk-up
• Runs only as conditions allow (needs a minimum snow base) - ask at the top whether it's running

blocks.title: Elf Headquarters
blocks.detail:
• Free kids' craft area: write letters to Santa and make DIY ornaments
• Open 10 AM-4 PM on Dec 24

blocks.title: Walk to the reindeer pen
blocks.detail: • Behind the skating pond

blocks.title: Reindeer Talk
blocks.detail:
• Meet Vixen, Grouse's resident reindeer
• Staff talk about her favourite foods and games - free, no booking (also at 3:00 PM)

blocks.title: Lunch - Lupins Cafe (Peak Chalet)
blocks.detail:
• Self-serve, main floor of the Peak Chalet - after the noon rush
• Burgers, hot dogs, mac & cheese, chicken tenders
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE from Lupins' posted summer 2026 menu board (winter menu may differ): Bacon Cheeseburger C$18 + Hot Honey Chicken Sandwich C$17 (adults) + Mac & Cheese C$12 + All Beef Canadian Hot Dog C$9 (kids) = C$56. Water. + 5% GST (C$2.80) = C$58.80, about US$42. Self-serve, no tip.

blocks.title: Buffer - more sledding or warm up
blocks.detail:
• Back to the Sliding Zone, or Christmas films on a loop in the Theatre in the Sky
• Skating dropped to keep the day relaxed - add it here if you're ahead (C$10 adult / C$6 child rentals)

blocks.title: Change out of wet snow gear at the car
blocks.detail: • Dry socks and layers

blocks.title: Drive Grouse → hotel
blocks.detail:
• FROM Grouse Mountain base → TO the hotel
• ~8 mi over the Lions Gate Bridge
• Leave the car with the valet for a short stay - you'll need it again at 4:05

blocks.title: Showers & wind-down at the hotel
blocks.detail:
• Showers, warm up, rest
• Dress warm for the evening lights

blocks.title: Car from the valet
blocks.detail:
• Call down for the car at 4:00
• Tip the valet C$5 (about US$3.60)
blocks.notes: Valet tip: C$5 when they bring the car up (about US$3.60) - US cash is fine too. Nothing needed at drop-off.

blocks.title: Drive to VanDusen Botanical Garden
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO VanDusen Botanical Garden
• ~5 mi south to 5251 Oak St
• On-site parking lot

blocks.title: VanDusen Festival of Lights
blocks.detail:
• Over a million lights across the 55-acre garden; catch one Dancing Lights show
• Timed entry - book the 4:45 PM slot (everyone needs a reservation)
• Standard hours 4-10 PM, closed Dec 25 - Christmas Eve hours not posted yet
blocks.notes: 2 adults x C$29 + 2 children (5-12) x C$12 = C$82 + 5% GST (C$4.10) = C$86.10, about US$62. Published 2026 prices; tickets go on sale Nov 4, 2026.

confLinks.label: VanDusen Festival of Lights — City of Vancouver

blocks.flag: Tickets go on sale Nov 4, 2026 - confirm Christmas Eve hours and book the 4:45 PM slot for Thu Dec 24.

blocks.title: Drive VanDusen → hotel
blocks.detail:
• FROM VanDusen → TO the hotel
• ~5 mi back downtown
• Valet the car for the night

blocks.title: Dinner at the hotel - Cloudstreet or Grain Tasting Bar
blocks.detail:
• In the Hyatt Regency - no walking or driving after VanDusen
• Grain Tasting Bar: lobby bar off Burrard St with a food menu
• Hotel's main restaurant (listed by Hyatt as Mosaic Grille; reported as Cloudstreet for 2026) - on Christmas Eve it may serve only its holiday buffet, so ask when you book
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE: about $100 for the family (Roque's budget).
blocks.flag: Reserve 6:30 PM Thu Dec 24 for four, and ask whether the regular menu runs alongside the Christmas Eve buffet.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail:
• Stockings out for Christmas morning
• Lights out by 8:45 PM keeps 10 hrs of sleep before a 7:00 AM Christmas morning

days.title: Christmas Day - Stanley Park & Robson Square (draft)

blocks.title: Christmas morning - presents in the room
blocks.detail: • Stockings and presents before breakfast

blocks.title: Breakfast - Mosaic Grille (hotel)
blocks.detail:
• 2nd floor; buffet or a la carte
• Globalist breakfast covers 2 adults + 2 kids
• Confirm Christmas morning hours at check-in

blocks.title: Get ready & car from the valet
blocks.detail:
• Warm layers - the seawall is breezy
• Tip the valet C$5 (about US$3.60)
blocks.notes: Valet tip: C$5 when they bring the car up (about US$3.60) - US cash is fine too. Nothing needed at drop-off.

blocks.title: Drive to Stanley Park
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO Stanley Park (start the one-way loop at the park entrance)
• ~2 mi along West Georgia St
• Pay parking lots inside the park (PayByPhone)

blocks.title: Stanley Park - Prospect Point, totem poles & Lost Lagoon
blocks.detail:
• Drive the one-way Stanley Park Drive loop with stops
• Prospect Point lookout over the Lions Gate Bridge
• Brockton Point totem poles and a short seawall walk
• Lost Lagoon on the way out
• The park is always open; few facilities run on Christmas Day
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE: pay parking about C$10 for the visit, about US$7. Rates vary by lot and season.

blocks.title: Back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• FROM Stanley Park → TO the hotel
• Valet the car

blocks.title: Light lunch - in-room dining
blocks.detail:
• Most restaurants are closed Christmas Day
• Keep it light before the 4:30 PM buffet
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE - in-room dining menu and holiday hours not posted online. About C$80 for sandwiches and kids' items, about US$58.

blocks.title: Walk to Robson Square
blocks.detail:
• FROM the hotel → TO Robson Square ice rink (below street level at Robson & Howe)
• ~5 min to 800 Robson St

blocks.title: Skating - Robson Square ice rink
blocks.detail:
• Free covered outdoor rink downtown
• Skate rentals C$5; helmets free and required for ages 12 and under
• Christmas Day hours were 11 AM-5 PM last season
blocks.notes: Skate rentals 4 x C$5 = C$20, about US$14. Hours from the 2025-26 season; confirm the 2026 schedule.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • FROM Robson Square → TO the hotel

blocks.title: Christmas buffet - Mosaic Grille (hotel)
blocks.detail:
• Christmas Day buffet in the hotel - no driving
• Seatings were 4:30 PM and 7:00 PM in 2025 - book the 4:30
• Reserve as soon as it's announced

blocks.detail:

• Peak eagle season is Dec-Jan; morning is a good viewing time
• Free; bring binoculars and stay on the dike

blocks.detail:

• Pay C$10 for the day with the PayByPhone app (lot number on the signs) or at Guest Services

blocks.notes: Sea to Sky Gondola parking: C$10 full day / C$8 half day, paid 'from open to close' (gondola's posted policy), about US$7 at ~0.72.

blocks.title: Sea to Sky Gondola up
blocks.detail:
• ~10 min ride to the Summit Lodge
• Family ticket online (2 adults + 2 kids)
blocks.notes: Family ticket C$165.95 online (2 adults + 2 child/youth), about US$119 at ~0.72; window price C$191.95, so buy online. Children 5 and under are free, but the family ticket is still cheaper than single tickets. Winter hours Nov 27-Dec 31: 9 AM-5 PM.
blocks.flag: Day tickets are valid any day until the printed expiry - safe to buy early online (C$165.95 family).

blocks.notes: C$5 x 4 = C$20, about US$14 at ~0.72. Open Sun-Fri 9 AM-5 PM once snow conditions permit.

• Grab a box for dessert / tomorrow morning
